bathAction.title: Wash tail
bathAction.tooltip: Draw the tail through the hands, from the base to the tip.

description.text: [npc.Name] [npc.verb(draw)] [npc.her] [npc.tail] through both hands, from the base out to the tip, working water into the hair or the scales or whatever the skin is there. [npc.She] [npc.verb(rinse)] until it runs clear. [npc.speech(Base to tip. The base is always the dirty part.)]

[npc.Name] [npc.verb(curl)] [npc.her] [npc.tail] into [npc.her] lap and [npc.verb(wash)] it slowly, enjoying the drag of wet hands along it. A pleased little sound leaves [npc.herHim]. [npc.speech(I forget how good it feels to have it clean.)]
[npc.Name] [npc.verb(grab)] [npc.her] [npc.tail] and [npc.verb(scrub)] from base to tip, then [npc.verb(rinse)] it and [npc.verb(let)] it go. [npc.speech(Clean. Stop waving it at me.)]
